title: Analysis code and derived data for: Bayesian hierarchical characterization of satellite photogrammetric elevation errors in forests using GEDI
description: Analysis code (R and Python) and derived site-level and forest-type-level tables supporting the manuscript 'Bayesian hierarchical characterization of satellite photogrammetric elevation errors in forests using GEDI' (submitted to ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing, 2026). The archive contains no Vantor Precision3D imagery or delivered elevation rasters and no per-footprint proprietary values.
